checks.name: cv_strategy_validity
checks.detail: validation_strategy.json.chosen_strategy=forward_expanding_time correctly applied: panel structure (jurisdiction x period_id), 5 folds, horizon=6 periods, expanding window trains strictly on past periods. cv_folds.json.scoring_restricted=True; OOF scored on 4590 rows (scoring categories all_drugs/all_opioids/all_stimulants in val folds only), matching leaderboard metric. Strategy correctly simulates hidden evaluation gap.

checks.name: cv_holdout_calibration
checks.detail: No holdout_score available (agent_gbdt.json holdout_score=null); calibration can only be assessed via OOF. Floor internal cv_mean for best single model (lightgbm_log)=0.882 vs canonical OOF floor=1.700 — a 1.93x discrepancy documented in ensemble_meta.json as different protocols (floor uses its own val splits, not canonical folds). gbdt canonical OOF=1.654 vs floor canonical OOF=1.700 → 2.7% improvement, well within expected range. Baseline best (group_category_mean) canonical OOF=1.884; gbdt achieves 12.2% improvement — plausible. Single-round CV improvement is 2.7% (well below 20% leakage threshold). Primary concern: inability to verify OOF vs held-out period calibration due to no holdout_score.

checks.name: prediction_sanity
checks.detail: CoV=0.698 (>>0.01, not near-constant). No clipping at bounds (0% at lower bound). Pred range [3.281, 54.542] within train range [0.050, 79.990]. KS(OOF vs preds)=0.056 (<0.5) — no concerning distribution shift between val and test predictions. OOF mean=13.295 vs pred mean=12.730, ratio=1.044 — healthy. WARN: prediction_sanity.json reports pred_mean/train_mean ratio=2.004, flagging potential shift. However train_mean=6.352 includes all 8 overdose categories (incl. sub-categories with lower rates), while predictions cover only the 3 scored categories (all_drugs/all_opioids/all_stimulants) which have structurally higher rates. The ratio reflects a legitimate category-level difference, not model drift. 20 predictions (2.2%) exceed train p99=38.392; within acceptable bounds.

checks.name: train_val_gap
checks.detail: No train_score available in agent_gbdt.json (train_score=null), so direct train-train gap cannot be computed. OOF=1.654 is the only available generalization estimate. Forward-expanding folds naturally produce some train-val gap as early periods are always in training; gap cannot be quantified without a holdout set. Distribution shift flagged in validation_strategy.json for gtrends_fentanyl (train mean=51.8, pred=68.8) and unemployment_rate (54.6% missing in pred vs 0% in train) suggests real-world generalization may be harder than OOF implies.

suggestions.suggestion: Record a temporal holdout score (last 6 periods withheld from all model selection) to validate OOF calibration. Currently holdout_score=null in agent_gbdt.json, leaving calibration gap unverified.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In modeling-specialist, after training on all canonical folds, evaluate on a fixed held-out block (e.g., periods 72-77 of period_order) and log holdout_score to agent_{fam}.json.

suggestions.suggestion: Address distribution shift in gtrends features (train mean 51.8 vs pred 68.8 for fentanyl) by using lag-differences or rank-normalised features rather than raw levels to reduce sensitivity to out-of-distribution covariate shift.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In feature_pipeline.py, replace raw gtrends_* columns with per-jurisdiction 1-period diff and 3-period rolling z-score.

suggestions.suggestion: Reconcile train_mean vs pred_mean reporting in prediction_sanity.json by restricting train_mean to scored categories (all_drugs/all_opioids/all_stimulants) to avoid misleading ratio=2.0 flag in future runs.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Filter training target to spec_parse.json.scoring_subset.scoring_values before computing train_mean in the sanity check.

notes: CV strategy is correctly specified (forward_expanding_time, scoring-restricted OOF). gbdt OOF block_mae=1.654 is a 2.7% improvement over floor and 12.2% over best baseline — plausible, no leakage signal. Main gap: no holdout_score to verify OOF calibration, and real covariate shift (gtrends, missing unemployment in pred) may cause OOF to underestimate test difficulty. No high-severity violations triggered.
